params.1266: Can We Hex It? Yes We Can!
params.1273: Build your house so that it has 6 rooms.
params.1274: Talk to an estate agent to buy a house, if you have not already.
params.1275: Enter your house portal in Build Mode.
params.1276: Right-click any white transparent door and select a new room to build.
params.1277: At level 20 you can build a new bedroom, which allows you to freely change your look. 2 bedrooms allow you to hire a servant!
